verdict.rationale: Aircall's API documents pausing and resuming recording on a call (aircall-docs-15), which implies call recording exists, and a tutorial covers importing recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure (aircall-docs-8), giving a programmatic way to get recordings back later. Nothing in the pack addresses consent announcements or jurisdiction-specific consent rules, and there is no in-app recording search or library. missing for 10: documented consent/disclosure handling per jurisdiction, explicit call-recording settings documentation, in-product search or browsing of recordings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
